Chicken bites, honey mustard.How to make it600g chicken thighs, diced250ml buttermilk150g plain flour1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp salt4 tbsp honey3 tbsp Dijon mustard1 L vegetable oil, for fryingSoak the chicken in buttermilk for an hour.Season the flour with paprika, garlic powder and salt and toss the chicken through it.Fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C for 4 minutes, in batches.Mix the honey and Dijon and serve with the chicken.Birthday party pulled pork slidersPulled pork in barbecue sauce on soft slider buns with apple slaw and picklesHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSmoky slow-roasted pork shoulder pulled and tossed in barbecue sauce, piled on soft slider buns with crunchy apple slaw and pickles.Rub a 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt.Put in a covered dish with 200ml apple juice and roast at 150°C for 4 hours until it pulls apart.Shred and toss with 200ml barbecue sauce.Shred a quarter cabbage and 1 green apple into matchsticks and toss with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar.Fill 12 split slider buns with pork, slaw and pickles.Pork gyoza with chilli oilPan-fried pork dumplings with chilli oil and soy for dippingHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main MealHolly's dinner night salmonRoast salmon with lemon dill butter and crushed potatoesHow to make it4 salmon fillets90g butter1 lemon, juiced1 tbsp chopped dill800g potatoes, boiled300g green beansBoil the potatoes until tender and crush with some of the butter.Roast the salmon skin side down at 220°C for 8 minutes.Melt some butter with the lemon juice and dill and spoon over.Steam the beans.Late-shift miso ramen with soft eggsSent home on a paid week off. Miso broth, ramen, pork belly, soy eggs.How to make itNot on tonight's cookRich miso and chicken broth over springy ramen noodles with seared pork belly, jammy soy eggs, corn, spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil.Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and soak in 100ml soy, 100ml water and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 hours.Slice 500g pork belly and pan fry until crisp.Heat 1.6 litres chicken stock with 2 grated garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger, then whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy off the boil.Cook 4 serves ramen noodles.Divide noodles and broth into bowls and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, spring onion and chilli oil.DessertSmiling cookiesWhatever you do, don't smile back.
